findings.problem: GET /health displays only plain text "ok", whereas R1 requires this path to return the full Hebrew RTL HTML page.
findings.fix: Serve render_page() with Content-Type text/html; charset=utf-8 for /health, just as for /.

findings.problem: White text on --green (#1f9d55) has approximately 3.5:1 contrast. This affects the primary call buttons, green hero stripe and final call-to-action heading, failing the required 4.5:1 contrast.
findings.fix: Darken the green backgrounds sufficiently to achieve at least 4.5:1 with white text, or use a suitably dark text color on these backgrounds.

findings.problem: Switching to English leaves the footer business description in Hebrew because its text has no translation attributes. The hero visual's accessible label also remains Hebrew, so the language switch does not translate all page text.
findings.fix: Add Hebrew and English translations for the footer business description and update the hero visual's aria-label when switching languages. Preserve the supplied phone and exact address.

findings.problem: The phone number displayed in the footer is plain text rather than a dialable link. Visitors cannot activate that displayed number, contrary to the requirement that every displayed phone have a tel: link.
findings.fix: Wrap the footer phone number in an anchor with href="tel:+972500000000", retaining its left-to-right display.

findings.problem: The red hero stripe uses white text on #e63946 (.stripes .r), giving approximately 4.17:1 contrast, below the explicitly required 4.5:1.
findings.fix: Darken the stripe's red background until white text reaches at least 4.5:1 contrast, or use a sufficiently contrasting dark text color.
